items.title: Market day at the Alter Markt, Magdeburg
items.context: A densely packed market crowds the Alter Markt in Magdeburg's old town before 1893, stalls and umbrellas filling the square in front of the surrounding townhouses.

items.title: Aachen Cathedral
items.context: Charlemagne's Palatine Chapel, its Carolingian octagonal dome fused with a soaring Gothic choir hall, forms the core of Aachen Cathedral, photographed ca. 1890s.

items.context: The fine arts museum on Augustusplatz, with its formal garden and the Mendebrunnen fountain visible at right, ca. 1890s.

items.title: The Welfenschloss (Guelph Palace), Hanover
items.context: The neo-Gothic Welfenschloss, built as a royal residence for the Kingdom of Hanover and later home to the Technical University, seen across its formal grounds, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Nuremberg Castle, west side
items.context: The Kaiserburg (Imperial Castle) rises above Nuremberg's old fortification walls and a timber footbridge over the moat gardens, ca. 1890s.

items.title: General view of Bremen from across the Weser
items.context: Barges ply the Weser river beneath Bremen's church spires, including St. Petri Cathedral, in a wide panoramic view from the western bank, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Neuer Markt and the Marienkirche, Rostock
items.context: A crowded market fills Rostock's Neuer Markt in front of the brick Gothic Marienkirche and the gabled Hanseatic townhouses lining the square, 1898.

items.title: Manchester Cathedral and the Cromwell statue

items.context: An electric tram bound for Levenshulme passes the statue of Oliver Cromwell in front of Manchester Cathedral's Gothic tower, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Cardiff Castle from the south-east
items.context: A horse-drawn omnibus passes the ivy-covered walls and William Burges's ornate clock tower at Cardiff Castle, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Royal Avenue, Belfast

items.title: Patrick Street, Cork
items.context: Horse trams run down Cork's curving main shopping street, Patrick Street, with St. Patrick's Hill rising behind, ca. 1890s.

items.title: St. George's Hall and Plateau, Liverpool
items.context: Horse trams and carriages cross the plateau before St. George's Hall, Liverpool's grand neoclassical concert hall and law court, with Wellington's Column visible beyond, ca. 1890s.

items.title: The Great Stack, Sheffield
items.context: American etcher Joseph Pennell captures a colossal factory chimney towering over Sheffield's smoke-wreathed steel-working skyline in 1909.

items.title: Birmingham city centre from the Mason College roof
items.context: A bird's-eye engraving of Birmingham's civic centre in 1886, showing the Council House, Town Hall, the Chamberlain Memorial fountain, and the Roman Catholic Cathedral dome at right.

items.title: Election night crowd at Leeds Town Hall, 1880
items.context: A vast crowd gathers before Leeds Town Hall's colonnade as the 1880 general election results are posted, the year William Gladstone stood for the Leeds seat.

items.title: College Green, Bristol
items.context: Bristol Cathedral's Gothic tower rises beyond College Green, with a statue of Queen Victoria (unveiled 1888) enclosed by railings on the green, ca. 1890s.

items.title: The Black Gate and Castle Keep, Newcastle upon Tyne
items.context: The medieval Black Gate and the castle keep it defended, with a railway viaduct crossing behind, in the city from which Newcastle takes its name, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Roman Mile Stone, Belgrave Gate, Leicester
items.context: Local artist John Flower depicts a Roman-inscribed milestone standing at Belgrave Gate, one of the old approaches into Leicester, in 1825.

items.title: Nottingham Castle from the avenue
items.artistOrCreator: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
items.context: The 17th-century ducal mansion built on the site of Nottingham's medieval castle crowns its sandstone bluff above a tree-lined avenue, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Union Terrace, Aberdeen
items.context: Aberdeen's granite Union Terrace overlooks the Denburn railway cutting and gardens, with His Majesty's Theatre's dome visible on the skyline, ca. 1890s.

items.title: The Roman Circular Bath
items.context: The excavated Roman Circular Bath, its steaming pool ringed by ancient stonework and Victorian iron railings, in the city that takes its name from these thermal springs, ca. 1890s.

items.title: Dundee from Princes Street
items.context: Scottish landscape painter Alexander Nasmyth captures Dundee's church spires and harbour on the Firth of Tay from the rising ground of Princes Street, ca. 1823.

items.title: St Michael's and Holy Trinity Churches from the North East, Coventry
items.context: Local painter David Gee depicts the twin spires of St Michael's and Holy Trinity, two of Coventry's famous 'three spires,' rising over the churchyard in 1849.

items.title: Inverness from the Castle
items.context: The River Ness winds through Inverness beneath a Victorian suspension footbridge, with the twin spires of St Andrew's Cathedral on the far bank, ca. 1890s.

items.title: York from the railway bridge
items.context: Barges moor along the River Ouse in York, with the twin west towers of York Minster rising above the city walls in the distance, ca. 1890s.

items.context: Cattle graze in Christ Church Meadow beneath the spires of Merton College Chapel and the Gothic Revival tower of Christ Church's Meadow Buildings, ca. 1890s.

items.context: Hansom cabs wait along King's Parade beside the soaring perpendicular Gothic windows and pinnacles of King's College Chapel, ca. 1890s.

items.context: A boy sits on the Shannon quayside gazing across the still river toward King John's Castle and the old town of Limerick, ca. 1895.
